notes: Large-source-unit check on אֶ֣בֶן וָ אָ֑בֶן: the flagged three-morpheme unit is retained. *diverse* answers to the repetition itself rather than to either noun or the waw, and *weights* writes the lexeme both nouns share, so no morpheme owns a part of the rendering; the split — *weights* on the first noun, *diverse* on the waw, the second noun unrepresented — would assign *diverse* arbitrarily (rules 2, 6, 30). Source head is the deterministic first token, target head the lexical anchor.
הָיָה is present, so the existential itself carries the *have*, the לְ is `unrepresented`, and the suffix takes the subject pronoun (rules 43, 40).
